draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 154th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 15th of 25 at RB. He lasted until pick 236, well after his grade rank (154th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,021 rushing yards in 2024, 18th of 25 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Jacksonville Jaguars. 17 career games and 1 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Weak spots: team carry share 5.0% (8th percentile), scrimmage td 0 (8th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 running back who played: 148 scrimmage yards against a median of 267, below the norm.
